title: Governance Receipt Manifest Enrichment v1
files_changed: rig_relay/evidence/receipt_store.py (REWRITTEN — enriched manifest rows with governance_decision_id, decision_status, surface, authority_tier, capability_id, content_light_classification, schema_version; added find_by_decision_id/surface/capability_id/authority_tier lookup helpers; added iter_manifest_rows(); added diagnose() with 4 diagnostic kinds; added ManifestDiagnostic dataclass)
rig_relay/evidence/receipt_envelope.py (MODIFIED — added optional request_id field to ReceiptEnvelope)
backward_compatibility_behavior: New manifest rows include enriched fields after created_at. Old manifest rows (4 columns: envelope_id, receipt_kind, session_id, created_at) remain readable — skipped fields return None in dict.get(). iter_manifest_rows() tolerates rows with or without new fields. find_by_* helpers skip rows where the lookup field is missing. list_by_session works identically with old and new rows.
lookup_helpers_added: find_by_decision_id(decision_id) → list[ReceiptEnvelope] — uses governance_decision_id from manifest
find_by_surface(surface) → list[ReceiptEnvelope] — uses surface from manifest
find_by_capability_id(capability_id) → list[ReceiptEnvelope] — uses capability_id from manifest
find_by_authority_tier(authority_tier) → list[ReceiptEnvelope] — uses authority_tier from manifest
iter_manifest_rows() → list[dict] — returns all manifest rows as dicts
request_id_decision: Added request_id as optional field (str | None) to ReceiptEnvelope. Defaults to None for backward compatibility. Populated by callers (MCP server already generates request_id; GovernanceRuntime can pass through). Survives round-trip through ReceiptStore.

detected_conditions: corrupted_shard — envelope JSON file fails json.loads
missing_shard — manifest references envelope_id not on disk
orphaned_shard — envelope file on disk with no manifest row
orphan_corruption_detection.behavior: Returns structured ManifestDiagnostic records (content-light: kind, envelope_id, manifest_line, reason). Does not raise exceptions. Does not auto-fix. Caller decides whether to quarantine or report.

dependency_changes: None. hashlib added to receipt_store imports (stdlib).
telemetry_redaction_implications: Manifest rows are content-light: only identifiers, hashes, status strings, and classification tags. No raw prompts, completions, private repo content, secrets, credentials, raw diffs, or raw Actions logs. ManifestDiagnostic records are content-light.
duckdb_postgres_source_of_truth_implicat: Enriched manifest reduces O(N) shard reads for governance decision queries. The 5 new manifest columns map directly to the DuckDB governance_decisions table (P1) and Postgres materialized view (P3). Manifest.jsonl remains the portable, inspectable, replayable source-of-truth.
remaining_replay_gaps: No timestamp range queries (manifest is append-only chronological; DuckDB projection needed for WHERE created_at BETWEEN)
No count validation between manifest and envelope directory (diagnose() detects but doesn't enforce)
No Paginated query support for find_by_* helpers (full scan of manifest)
No evidence_status (persisted/failed) in manifest — ReceiptEnvelope.decision doesn't include evidence_persisted field yet
No trace_id in ReceiptEnvelope or manifest
No input_hash/output_hash in ReceiptEnvelope or manifest
next_recommended_implementation_slice: P1: DuckDB governance_decisions read-side projection. Build a disposable DuckDB table from manifest.jsonl + sharded envelope JSON files. Enable SQL queries, time-range lookups, and paginated results. Validate that projection counts match manifest and envelope file counts.
completed_work: Enriched manifest.jsonl to include governance_decision_id, decision_status, surface, authority_tier, capability_id, content_light_classification, schema_version
Added iter_manifest_rows() for raw manifest access
Added optional request_id to ReceiptEnvelope with round-trip support
Added ManifestDiagnostic dataclass and diagnose() method detecting 4 conditions (corrupted shard, corrupted manifest line, missing shard, orphaned shard)
Backward-compatible: old 4-column manifest rows remain readable; enriched rows add fields after created_at
Created 26 tests covering manifest enrichment, backward compatibility, lookup helpers, request_id, and corruption/orphan diagnostics
